item.title: Siamese Neural Network for Label-Efficient Critical Phenomena Prediction in 3D Percolation Models
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shanshan Wang, Dian Xu, Jianmin Shen, Feng Gao, Wei Li, Weibing Deng
arXiv:2507.14159v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Predicting critical phenomena from limited labeled data remains a challenging task in statistical physics. As percolation theory provides a canonical model for phase transitions with well-established critical exponents, it serves as an ideal benchmark for validating new machine learning frameworks. Here, we introduce a label-efficient learning framework based on a Siamese Neural Network (SNN) to identify phase transitions in three-dimensional site and bond percolation models. Using only 22 labeled probability points drawn entirely from non-critical regions, the method locates percolation thresholds with percent-level accuracy and yields estimates of the critical exponent ν consistent with literature values within statistical uncertainty.…

item.title: 解码磁性织构
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Michael P. Path, Jeffrey McCord, Michael Vogel
该研究利用受控磁光推断实验，从铋取代钇铁石榴石薄膜中高对比度、像素分辨的光学偏振图像重建磁场、温度与磁历史。作者结合深度卷积神经网络和基于人工设计物理可解释特征的神经网络推断，分析磁畴形貌与外部刺激之间复杂、非线性且受滞后影响的关系。结果表明，磁性织构可作为高保真信息载体，用于反推出材料所经历的外部条件。

item.title: 用于合金中化学、自旋与结构无序耦合研究的多尺度机器学习框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zhenyao Fang, Qimin Yan
该工作提出一种结合图神经网络、机器学习原子间势以及蒙特卡洛/分子动力学采样的通用框架，用于统一处理合金中的化学、自旋和结构自由度。作者以含间隙碳的体心立方 Fe-Co 合金为例，研究宿主的化学与自旋无序以及碳掺杂引起的局域晶格畸变。该框架预测的有序-无序相变温度和熔点分别约为 1000 K 和 1690 K，与实验值高度一致，显示出处理多重无序磁性合金热力学性质的潜力。

item.title: 通过编码轨道投影态密度进行材料性质机器学习
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Paulo Pires, Pierre-Paul De Breuck, Mauro Fava, Hai-Chen Wang, Miguel A. L. Marques
该研究提出将由密度泛函理论计算得到的位点投影轨道态密度指纹加入图神经网络的原子节点表示，以改进材料性质预测。该表示与 Pettifor 元素嵌入在每个原子位点融合后再进行消息传递，相比仅使用静态元素描述符能更好反映晶体中原子的量子电子环境。对于超导临界温度和光学介电常数预测，pDOS 增强分别将误差降低 22.9% 和 27.9%，效果接近于将训练集规模翻倍；不过提升幅度依赖训练数据量。

item.title: BatteryMat：用于锂离子正极材料平均电压筛选的分层机器学习与DFT框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jaehyung Lee, Charles Rhys Campbell, Kent Zhang, Kamal Choudhary
该文提出 BatteryMat，一个结合机器学习、力场脱锂曲线和自动化密度泛函理论计算的三层框架，用于快速筛选锂离子电池正极材料的平均电压。其以 ALIGNN 作为初筛信号，再用 ALIGNN-FF 与 PBE+U 或 optB88-vdW+U 超胞 DFT 验证候选材料，并自动选择交换-相关泛函与重新计算锂金属参考能。作者报告 ALIGNN 对力场标签具有较高蒸馏精度，但强调这反映的是对力场协议的拟合，而非直接等同于 DFT 或实验一致性。

item.title: 机器学习原子间势真的实用吗？23 种主流模型的基准测试
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hanwen Kang, Tenglong Lu, Sheng Meng, Miao Liu
该研究指出现有机器学习原子间势基准多强调静态精度，而忽视推理效率和硬件可扩展性。作者在低成本 NVIDIA DGX Spark 平台上，以统一 ASE 流程和固定 192 原子体系测试 23 种主流开源模型，评估预测精度、分子动力学吞吐量和原子数可扩展性。结果显示高精度大型模型相较轻量模型仅提升约 3–5 meV/atom，却可能牺牲数个数量级的吞吐量；轻量模型更常位于精度-效率 Pareto 前沿，说明未来模型发展应同时重视效率、可扩展性与精度。

item.title: An Hybrid Quantum-Classical Diffusion Model for Image Generation
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Qipeng Qian, Keli Deng, Yuntao Qian
arXiv:2607.07072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum diffusion models provide a physics-consistent route to generative learning by formulating noising and denoising directly on quantum states. However, applying such models to classical high-dimensional data is constrained by the qubit cost of state encoding and the computational burden of simulating large density operators. We propose a scalable hybrid generative pipeline that combines a classical autoencoder for dimensionality reduction with a mixed-state quantum denoising diffusion probabilistic model (MSQuDDPM) operating in the learned latent space. The autoencoder compresses data into compact latent codes that can be embedded into a small-qubit Hilbert space, after which the quantum diffusion model learns a generative distribution…

item.title: 在超导处理器上利用强化学习进行量子编译
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Z T Wang, Qiuhao Chen, Yuxuan Du, Z H Yang, Xiaoxia Cai, Kaixuan Huang, Jingning Zhang, Kai Xu, Jun Du, Yinan Li, Yuling Jiao, Xingyao Wu, Xiliang Lu, Huikai Xu, Yirong Jin, Ruixia Wang, Haifeng Yu and S P Zhao
该研究在超导量子处理器上评估了基于强化学习的量子编译器，目标是在噪声中等规模量子设备上生成更短、更适配硬件的量子线路。实验显示，对于双量子比特线路，该方法优于传统编译方法；但在三量子比特线路中理论保真度不足。作者进一步结合变分策略，形成变分强化学习编译器，在严格硬件约束下仍能稳定找到近最优线路，并分析退相干与门误差的影响。

item.title: Quantum machine learning performance evaluation for air pollution assessment with benchmarking and comparative analysis using multi-metric scoring and quantum circuit expressibility
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Jagadish Kumar Mogaraju
Our study proposes the MDQ-3L framework, a multi-metric, quantum-aware hierarchy for benchmarking classical machine learning, deep learning, and quantum machine learning models in air quality prediction. PM2.5, PM10, NO, NO2, NOx, NH3, CO, SO2, O3, Benzene, Toluene, and Xylene were considered predictors of AQI. Seventeen ML regressors, nine DL models, and seven QML circuits were evaluated using MAE, MSE, RMSE, R², RMSLE, MAPE, and QML-specific expressibility (0.739-2.0) and entangling power (0-0.398). Aggregated via min-max normalization and weights, the framework penalizes negative R² and high structural costs, yielding CatBoost and DBN as top performers, while QML trailed by 25–40% in composite scores due to generalization gaps and barren plateau risks. MDQ-3L aligns circuits to targets…

item.description:

👤 Kwame Agyei-Baah, Muhammad Rizwanur Rahman, E. R. Smith
arXiv:2601.11946v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modelling fluid dynamics with machine learning (ML) has advanced rapidly, yet most data driven approaches remain opaque because they rely on complex architectures to capture nonlinear flow behaviour. item.title: Learning Turbulence Closures with Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Rayleigh-Taylor Transition to Turbulence

👤 Paul Creusy, Benoît-Joseph Gréa, Antoine Briard, Téo Granger
arXiv:2607.07020v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) turbulence models are known to perform poorly in predicting the dynamics of Rayleigh-Taylor mixing when turbulence is not fully developed, particularly during the transition from an initially perturbed interface. The turbulence model is first embedded within a surrogate physics-informed neural network (PINN), enabling the calibration of coefficients that account for parametric errors and the identification of corrective terms representing structural errors associated with missing physical processes. The learned corrections are then re-expressed onto the model state variabl…

item.title: CoFINN: Conservation Flux Informed Neural Networks for Physics Problems Governed by Conservation Laws
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Adnan Harun Doğan, Mert Deniz, Hande Alemdar, Özgür Uğraş Baran
arXiv:2607.06587v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present CoFINN (Conservation Flux Informed Neural Networks), a physics-informed deep learning framework for predicting compressible flow fields governed by conservation laws. Unlike conventional data-driven convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which optimize only pixel-wise similarity metrics, CoFINN embeds finite-volume conservation physics directly into the training process. Unlike classical physics-informed methods which enforce differential-equation residuals at collocation points through automatic differentiation, CoFINN adopts a finite-volume perspective consistent with modern CFD methodology. item.title: 交替磁体中由磁振子-声子耦合实现的对称性强制手性声子
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Philipp Rieger, Markus Weißenhofer, Sergiy Mankovsky, Peter M. Oppeneer
该研究表明，在破缺 PT 对称性的交替磁体系中，零外场下可通过相对论性磁振子-声子耦合产生手性声子。以典型交替磁体 CrSb 为例，作者利用第一性原理计算整个布里渊区中的杂化磁振子-极化子，并发现耦合可将交替磁的 g 波对称性 imprint 到声子角动量上。研究还展示了由有限 Berry 曲率导致的反常自旋与声子角动量能斯特响应，指向零场自旋热电子学和手性声子学应用。

item.title: Spin Textures and Eigenstate Evolution of Isospectrally Patterned Lattices
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Peter Schmelcher
arXiv:2607.07502v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Isospectrally patterned lattices exhibit a composite band structure with a tunable ratio of localized versus delocalized eigenstates that is controlled by the underlying phase gradient. We show that the lattice Hamiltonian can be interpreted as that of a single spin exposed to a rotating magnetic field which is allowed to hop with a spin-flip across the lattice. In the low- and high-energy part of the band the localized states show an envelope of oscillatory character separated by quasi-nodes. Spin peaks occur at the locations of these quasi-nodes and provide a unique spin texture to the eigenstates which becomes increasingly complex with increasing degree of excitation. The crossover from localization to delocalization and vice versa leav…

item.title: 超薄铁磁体居里温度附近涨落驱动的自旋轨道力矩增强
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mateusz Szurek, Sergei Ivanov, Sergei Urazhdin
该研究考察了受限导致居里温度降低的超薄磁性异质结构中，磁涨落如何影响自旋轨道力矩。在居里温度以上，阻尼型自旋轨道场显著增强，而场型分量受到抑制，且二者呈现相反的磁场依赖。作者认为这些现象源于涨落诱导的纵向与横向界面自旋电导混合，从而增强铁磁体对横向极化自旋流的吸收，并指出该机制可用于类似热辅助磁记录的自旋电子方案。

item.title: 交替磁体中的自旋轨道磁性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ruojia Wang, Yuntian Liu, Renzheng Xiong, Xiaobing Chen, Qihang Liu
该文研究反铁磁体及交替磁体在净磁化极小的情况下仍能表现显著反常霍尔效应的机制。作者结合定向自旋群理论与自旋轨道耦合张量展开，区分轨道磁化与自旋磁化相对于自旋轨道耦合的微扰行为。研究发现，在特定四重旋转关联的交替磁体中会出现同轴霍尔效应，诱导的自旋与轨道磁化沿 Néel 矢量排列，并通过 KV₂Se₂O 的第一性原理计算加以展示。

item.title: Stripe antiferromagnetism and chiral superconductivity in tWSe₂
item.description:

arXiv:2601.20836v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The layer-dependent Hamiltonians of parallel-stacked MoTe₂ and WSe₂ homobilayer moiré materials are topologically non-trivial, both in real space and in momentum space, and have been shown to support integer and fractional quantum anomalous Hall states, as well as antiferromagnetic and superconducting states. Here, we address the interplay between the antiferromagnetic and superconducting states observed in tWSe₂ when the Fermi level is close to its M-point van Hove singularity and the displacement field is small. We combine DFT with path-integrals to construct a minimal moiré band model that accounts for lattice relaxation along the c-axis and perform Hartree-Fock calculations to identify competing charge and spin ordered states. item.title: S = 1/2 反铁磁双钙钛矿 SrLaCoNbO₆ 中 Kitaev 磁性与复杂自旋-晶格耦合的拉曼光谱特征
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ajay Kumar, Clemens Ulrich, Rajendra S. Dhaka
该研究对赝自旋 1/2 绝缘反铁磁体 SrLaCoNbO₆ 进行了温度依赖拉曼光谱和 Co K 边 EXAFS 分析。拉曼声子频率、线宽和谱重在约 60 K 附近出现明显异常，远高于约 15 K 的长程反铁磁转变温度，表明晶格与自旋自由度之间存在显著耦合。160–180 K 附近还观测到高、低能拉曼模的线宽、强度和 Fano 不对称性变化以及额外低能特征，提示离散声子与涨落磁激发之间存在耦合，并可能与 Kitaev 型磁性相关。

item.title: K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂ 两个耦合 trillium 晶格中短程自旋关联与弱磁有序的多阶段发展
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 J. Khatua, Sritharan Krishnamoorthi, Changhyun Koo, Gyungbin Ban, Taeyun Kim, Yugo Oshima, Marc Uhlarz, John Wilkinson, Peter J. Baker, Kyeong Jun Lee, Mani Shankar, Seo Hyoung Chang, R. Sankar, Kwang-Yong Choi
该研究通过磁化率、比热、电子自旋共振和 μ 子自旋弛豫研究 K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂ 单晶中两个耦合 trillium 晶格的磁性。实验显示强反铁磁相互作用与 5.2 K 的弱磁有序共存，并由磁化率中的 λ 型异常、μSR 弛豫率临界增强及 ESR 信号消失支持。在 Néel 温度以上，34 K 和 10 K 附近分别出现两阶段短程自旋关联的发展；低于有序温度后，3.2 K 的异常表明残余相互作用可能诱导自旋重取向。

item.title: 压力下 MnSi 自旋波的波长分辨小角中子谱研究
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 E. V. Altynbaev, D. O. Skanchenko, Z. Xie, Y. Ke, Y. Bao, A. V. Tsvyashchenko
该工作报道了在中国散裂中子源 BL01 飞行时间小角中子散射仪上开展的波长分辨自旋波小角中子散射，并将该方法扩展到 MnSi 的压力池测量。作者以 B20 螺旋磁体 MnSi 为基准，通过分析不同中子波长下相对于 Bragg 角重心校正后的截止角，线性拟合得到自旋波刚度。常压测量再现了 MnSi 已知的刚度尺度；在名义 11 kbar 下，根据当前截止模型得到的刚度明显降低，同时结构 SANS 用于验证磁态并提供压力状态的内部检查。

item.title: 竞争的铁电序与近晶序：通过分子设计实现调制结构
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Grant J. Strachan, Ewa Górecka, Jadwiga Szydłowska, Damian Pociecha
该研究表明，可通过分子工程系统调节极性有序与位置有序之间的平衡，从而控制极性和调制液晶相的出现。作者发现，由芳香核心自分离和足够长端链促进的极性正交近晶相会被强纵向偶极相互作用去稳定化，而倾斜铁电 SmCF 相在整个同系物系列中保持高度稳健，说明分子倾斜可缓解层内偶极挫折。研究还显示，微相分离与静电相互作用共同稳定了新的调制 SmCM 相，其特征为非公度电子密度波，尤其在短端链化合物中更明显。

item.title: 通过面积比工程化铁电 AlScN 栅堆栈实现非易失存储与模拟计算集成的单片 GaN 系统
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hyeong Jun Joo, Jong Min Park, Kieran Barrett-Snyder, Brendan Hanrahan, Geonwook Yoo
该研究展示了采用 AlScN 铁电栅堆栈的 GaN 晶体管，并通过调控 SMIS/SMFM 面积比统一控制存储与模拟功能。通过精确调节中间电极长度，器件实现了 27 V 的高存储窗口和 27 mV/dec 的正向亚阈值摆幅，源于二维电子气预诱导的稳定向下极化态及其反转。低面积比器件实现 4 位多级存储并在 4×4 阵列中表现出良好均匀性，高面积比器件则利用连续可调电导态展示多态反相器等模拟计算功能。

item.title: 螺旋选择性反铁磁共振的非厄米调控
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Masato Todani, Satoshi Iihama, Yuto Moritake, Takeo Kato
